question: A number of people were killed and dozens injured at a religious ceremony on 23 October 2026, when a terrorist attack was carried out on the Greek Orthodox church of Saint George in Hmoud in the Jordanian city of Karak1. This heinous attack highlights the need for effective protection of Christian communities and other religious minorities in Jordan from terrorism and religious hatred.

In the Joint Statement of the Jordan-EU Summit of 8 January 20262 a commitment was made towards cooperation against religious discrimination, the promotion of interreligious dialogue and towards countering terrorism and violent extremism. In view of the above, can the Vice-President of the Commission / High Representative of the Union for Foreign Affairs and Security Policy answer the following: 1.

What immediate measures does she intend to take, in cooperation with the Jordanian authorities and the Patriarchate of Jerusalem, to protect believers and places of worship and support those affected?
How will she make use of financial tools and cooperation between the EU and Jordan to prevent extremist attacks and counter religious hatred?
Does she intend to undertake a specific initiative, with concrete actions and a timetable, for the safety of Christian communities and other religious minorities in Jordan?
